messages.subject: Re: Duplicate-looking accounts
messages.body:
Which owner ID will Support get if it opens the shared entry? Both registrations already have verified IDs.

Either spelling could land in the same similarity bucket. I’d have Audit check each name against its own record before issuing an export.

messages.subject: Re: Duplicate-looking accounts
messages.body:
Agreed on the export. Keep the bucket lookup for diagnostics. Require a match against each retained registration before the export opens.

Audit kept the pre-merge lengths, scripts and a limited byte comparison from the source records.
